messages:
elaine: pushed a small follow-up to PR #923 to address the style nits from review — renamed `fooBar` -> `foo_bar`, split the long function into two, and ran the formatter. PTAL when you have a minute.

sam: thanks! quick q — did you change the public API name? we use foo_bar in a couple places so want to avoid churn

derek: I skimmed the diff, looks fine. only question is the helper name: `serialize_user_meta` vs `serialize_user_metadata` — prefer shorter? not a blocker.

elaine: @sam no public API change, only internal helpers. I left a comment in the callsites to make it clear. @derek good point — I went with `serialize_user_meta` to keep line length down.

katie: lint-bot flagged one formatting issue earlier, CI is rerunning? @ci-bot any failures remaining?

ci-bot: CI re-run triggered by elaine. Running: unit tests, mypy, flake8. Current status: running.

lint-bot: flake8: 1 issue -> trailing whitespace in pkg/serving/utils.py:42. I added a suggestion in the PR.

elaine: fixed the trailing whitespace and pushed — also added a tiny docstring to the new helper.

ci-bot: CI passed: all checks green :white_check_mark:

sam: lgtm from me, thanks for addressing the nits :+1:

derek: lgtm as well. one optional follow-up: can we add a quick unit test for the helper in a separate PR? not needed to block this.

katie: since CI is green and we have 2 approvals, feel free to merge after rebasing if needed. I'll watch for releases if it touches serving infra.

elaine: will rebase and merge in ~10m. thanks everyone! :sparkles:

katie: noted, if merge causes a small rollout blip please ping #eng-oncall.

elaine: will do. merging now.

(merge commit created by elaine)
